summary: Compares the expected path string (this+0xB0, falling back to global byte_5EA438) against the currently loaded path string (this+0xE8, same fallback). When the paths match and the video is not yet loaded (this+0xE4 null) while the resource handle (this+0xE0) is non-null, it obtains a render context via GlobalAccessor_5150(&unk_7CDE00), renders one Bink video frame at the stored coordinates (this+0xC, this+0x4) via BinkVideoFrameRender with the constant 32, and signals a content change through vtable slot offset 44 with argument 1. When the paths differ, it calls vtable slot offset 160 to reload/reinitialize the video. Returns 0 on every path.

operations.description: Load the expected path pointer from this+0xB0; when null substitute the global default byte_5EA438.
Load the currently loaded path pointer from this+0xE8; when null substitute byte_5EA438.
strcmp the two path strings; equal paths take the render branch, differing paths take the reload branch.
The render branch requires this+0xE4 (video loaded-state pointer) to be null; when already loaded it skips rendering and returns 0.
The render branch also requires this+0xE0 (video resource handle) to be non-null.
GlobalAccessor_5150(&unk_7CDE00) returns the render surface/context for the frame draw.
BinkVideoFrameRender(context, this+0xC, this+0x4, 32) draws one Bink video frame at the stored render coordinates.
Invoke the vtable slot at offset 44 (dispatched through the this+0x0 vtable) as a __thiscall with argument 1 to signal that content changed.
Invoke the vtable slot at offset 160 (dispatched through the this+0x0 vtable) with no extra argument to reload/reinitialize the video.

unresolved: Identity of the owning object and the meaning of its vtable slots at offsets 44 and 160 is unknown.
Meaning of the constant 32 passed to BinkVideoFrameRender (bit depth or flags) is unresolved.
When this+0xE4 is already non-null the matching branch renders nothing and returns 0; whether that is intentional is unresolved.
Which path string is the requested resource and which is the actually loaded one is inferred, not confirmed.
